description:
Serverless HTML-to-PDF for .NET 8 - runs in-process on Azure Functions (including the Consumption plan), AWS Lambda and containers
      with no headless browser, no Chromium, no native binaries and no browser cold start. Zero-dependency,
      pure C#, one managed DLL. Renders modern CSS (flexbox, grid, gradients, transforms), SVG, PDF/A
      (incl. PDF/A-3 hybrid invoices with embedded XML - EU Factur-X / ZUGFeRD) and PDF/UA, built-in QR and
      barcode generation, and right-to-left scripts (Arabic, Hebrew). Cross-platform (Windows/Linux), no AGPL.
releaseNotes:
1.0.11 - CSS 3D transforms, multi-column and footnote layout, typography and layout-correctness fixes.

NEW: CSS 3D transforms (perspective, rotateX/Y/Z, translateZ, matrix3d, transform-style: preserve-3d, backface-visibility) as vector output. Footnotes (float: footnote) reserve a footnote area, so body text no longer runs under the notes. Inline sub/sup and vertical-align (sub, super, lengths, percentages, middle, text-top, text-bottom) on text. font-weight matching by number (CSS Fonts 4), synthetic oblique, Times and Courier italics, bolder/lighter against the parent. text-align-last, line-clamp, text-orientation, inline-size/block-size and their min/max forms.

FIXES: Multi-column: decorated paragraphs and block boxes split across columns with box-decoration-break slice/clone, bare text and inline content flow across columns, column-gap: normal is 1em. Parent/child margin collapsing, auto table column distribution, float shrink-to-fit insets and max-height on auto-height blocks follow CSS 2.1. Tall lines in a paragraph that crosses a page no longer run past the page bottom. Bidi brackets are paired for the whole paragraph. Link annotations are no longer recorded twice for table cells.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGES vs 1.0.10 - re-render and compare existing documents before upgrading: margins now collapse through a parent and its first/last child; sub/sup text is raised and smaller; column-gap: normal is 1em instead of 11.25pt; footnote areas shrink the page's body area; font-weight 500 is no longer bold.

1.0.10 - CSS correctness and linear barcodes.

NEW: Linear barcodes on ConverterProperties.Barcodes - Code 128, GS1-128, EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A, alongside QR Code, PDF417, Aztec and Data Matrix (bars only; put the human-readable digits in your HTML). CSS that was previously parsed and silently ignored now renders: border-collapse, border-spacing, empty-cells, caption-side, list-style-position and flex-flow, plus background-size, background-repeat, place-content, list-style-image, and logical inline properties (margin/padding/border-inline-*) that follow direction. CSS-wide keywords inherit / initial / unset. GPOS pair kerning and letter-/word-spacing for embedded fonts. SVG text elements are drawn through the HTML text path (shaping, bidi, font fallback, rotation). A gradient set on body/html now paints as the page background. display:inline-block works on block elements (div, section, p), so they sit side by side. Transforms resolve calc(), percentages and font-relative lengths. LayoutDiagnostics now reports an inconsistent table column structure.

FIXES: List markers are sized from the widest marker the list draws, so item 10 and beyond no longer overlap their text, and a marker is never stranded at the foot of a page without its item. Floats that do not fit move to the next page; fixed-height boxes end on the right page; a forced break after empty content is honoured; flex lines paginate. Opacity applies to an element as one transparency group. Grid template-less and fit-content track sizing.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGES vs 1.0.9 - re-render and compare existing documents before upgrading: (1) Tables default to border-collapse:separate with 2px border-spacing (the CSS 2.1 initial value; 1.0.9 defaulted to collapse) - declare border-collapse:collapse to keep the previous look. (2) Line baselines use the font's ascent/descent with half-leading (CSS 2.1 10.8.1), so text sits about 0.13em lower. (3) Automatic shrink-to-fit never scales a page below 1/1.5 (about 67%). (4) img is an atomic inline-level box. (5) body margin/padding/border form a real box that offsets the content, and the html background paints the page canvas; the default body margin stays 0. (6) display:inline-block on block elements now lays out inline.

Also shipped in 1.0.9 but not listed in its notes: multi-column pagination with column-width, column-fill and column-rule; named @page sizes and margins; ::marker styling; break-inside:avoid-page and break-after:avoid; box-shadow fixes for #RGBA colours, mm/cm/in lengths and rgba() alpha; a width:100% table no longer collapses after a fixed-width sibling.

Previous 1.0.x notes remain in git history.
title: Bhowra.Ink - HTML to PDF for .NET
